initial_structure: Same POSCAR geometry as the frozen baseline; displace the last atom by +0.10 angstrom along Cartesian x.
settings: Use validation/protocol.v1.json parameters, with fixed-cell ISIF=2 (cell_relax=false).
failure_policy: Preserve failure under this protocol. Any parameter or threshold change requires a separately versioned case; it cannot repair the old score.
scope: Demonstrates real atomic coordinate optimization in two simple nonmagnetic PBE cases, not universal relaxation reliability or experimental accuracy.
